title: 秋冬の行事の塗り絵
lead: お月見・ハロウィン・七五三・餅つき・雪だるまなど、秋から冬の行事を線画にした塗り絵12点です。印刷して配布できます。
subject_en: Coloring pages of autumn and winter events, each ONE big simple scene or object, centred, drawn with thick, clean, closed black outlines only and NOTHING filled in: the inside of every shape stays plain white. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: a big full moon with pampas grass and dango on a stand
a smiling jack-o'-lantern pumpkin with a witch hat
a child in kimono holding a long candy bag
a rabbit pounding rice cake with a mallet and mortar
a snowman with a scarf, bucket hat and broom
a big maple leaf and ginkgo leaves with an acorn
a roasted sweet potato wrapped in paper with steam
a cat curled up under a kotatsu table with a tangerine
a bathtub with floating yuzu fruits and a towel
a three-tier osechi box with simple festive foods
a kadomatsu pine and bamboo decoration
a sleigh with gift sacks and a reindeer
